learning.title: What to test next
learning.titleHint: How much testing this hypothesis would advance knowledge: it combines potential value, uncertainty and the lack of data. The higher, the more useful it is to test this one.
learning.valueHint: What we gain if the hypothesis is confirmed.
learning.uncertaintyHint: How unclear the outcome still is — the higher, the more we learn by testing.
learning.evidenceGapHint: How thin the evidence base is: less data means a higher payoff from testing.

experiment.taskFailed: Failed to draft the experiment plan
experiment.aiNote: The plan is suggested by AI from the knowledge base — review it before running
experiment.empty: No plan yet. Draft one — what to test, parameters, measurement methods, controls and a success criterion — so the hypothesis can be tested in practice.

relationText.supports: the fragment contains a result or condition that works in favour of the claimed effect.
relationText.contradicts: the fragment points to a limitation, a negative result or a condition that argues against the claimed effect.
relationText.context: the fragment provides conditions, methodology or material for testing, but does not by itself prove the effect.

itc.title: Research profile

facts.SM: Dates are known for {{dated}} of {{total}} documents · {{years}}.
facts.NV: Semantic comparison used texts from {{count}} of {{total}} documents.
facts.NVLegacy: Semantic distance from the current corpus center. The text sample size was not recorded.
facts.IP: Links from hypotheses to this theme’s documents: {{amount}}.
facts.HR: {{documents}} documents in the theme; {{organizations}} organizations found in the inspected sample.

itc.reading: Each scale compares the theme with others in this corpus. 50 is the median. The index combines four indicators with different weights.
itc.readiness: Assessed separately from experiments, tests and prototype performance. Publication activity alone does not demonstrate readiness for deployment.
itc.incomplete: Provisional calculation: some indicators lack data.
itc.method: The index is the sum of four contributions. Each contribution equals the indicator value multiplied by its weight. Weights and contributions below come from the stored calculation.
itc.limitations: The comparison applies only to the current corpus. Changing its composition changes the ranks. An unavailable indicator contributes a neutral value of 50; this makes the result provisional and does not create a map coordinate. Semantic difference does not establish scientific novelty, and hypothesis links are not external citations.

provenance.title: How it originated
provenance.fallback: The model was unavailable — the draft was assembled from retrieved fragments without generation.
provenance.bridgeIntro: The system found a “bridge”: two knowledge-base themes are semantically close yet almost unconnected directly — and proposed a hypothesis at their intersection.

scales.maverickHint: The themes are semantically close yet almost unlinked directly — a sign of a non-obvious idea
scales.bridgingHint: How strongly the mediator documents actually connect the themes
scales.affinityHint: How much the themes are about the same thing at all

provenance.gateGrounding: All evidence cites real documents from the base
provenance.noveltySimBefore: : the closest similar text matches at
provenance.clusterWithLabel: Assembled automatically from the theme “{{label}}” — as reconnaissance of a promising area, not a verified claim.
provenance.clusterNoLabel: Assembled automatically from a knowledge-base theme — as reconnaissance of a promising area, not a verified claim.
provenance.onDemand: Generated for a thesis from knowledge-base fragments: the system retrieved relevant documents, extracted mechanisms and assembled a testable claim.
provenance.betNoAnswer: No radar answer found for this forecast: it is not saved yet or the technology dropped out of the results.
